verdict: Organic engagement is your only active signal; paid channels remain off.
narrative: Across all three locations this period, no paid advertising ran on Meta or Google Ads — every contact and action came through your Google Business Profiles. Combined, the three profiles generated 388 total actions (directions, calls, and web clicks) in the last 28 days, which shows meaningful local search presence. However, all three locations recorded zero GBP activity in the final three to four days of the period, and O'Hare Precision's search clicks fell 41% week-over-week — signals we're watching closely for listing visibility issues. We're investigating the recent flatline across profiles and reviewing local ranking factors to stabilize and recover engagement heading into the next period.
